essence: By abiding in the limit of consciousness, the yogin rests beyond temporal division in a mere instant.
Because time is limiting appearance, the yogin who devours it attains the freedom of a sky-mover.
Since manifestation is only the play of one's own rays, restraining them blocks the entire sphere of paths.
Scriptural authority confirms that relishing the devouring of time leads spontaneously to the khecara state.
Through restraint of the rays and tasting the supreme nectar in the unlimited present, one becomes happy.
